text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …I blew it again. I just can't get it right.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My plan to reel in the big catch needed more time in the oven… and so did my prep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sincerely, I'm real sorry I let you down.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I'm gonna learn from my losses! And I'm gonna make the most of the next opportunity I get!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But if I give up now, there's no way I'll ever make it to first place.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And for all the training I skimped out on before, well, next time I'm gonna train to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And you know what that means! You'll wanna stay tuned to see what I get up to next!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What's this? You've still got your hopes hanging on me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: On me, a plain ol' Umamusume who can't do much else but plot and plan…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I wouldn't be much of a racer if I went and let you down—not with all that support you're sending my way!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Seriously, it's not like I was planning on giving up and running away or whatever…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, how's about we go fishing? We'll be on the lookout for lunkers, obviously!
